Admin page displays revenue, costs, payments and credit accounts; concise আর্থিক হিসাব describes the financial overview more directly than economic-system অর্থব্যবস্থা.

The check tests continuation from saved state, not starting a fresh run. Inspected AI_CHECK_LABELS.continuation; aligns Hindi/Urdu/French/Malay continue/resume wording.

context_notes: AI validation labels are test categories; persistent state and continuation do not imply restarting a new match.
Connection Good/Fair/Poor indicate quality; relay is a network server. Threshold and buffer quantities preserved.
Material names describe texture/finish; Scales is animal scales, Cloud is the material appearance, Chrome is metallic finish rather than browser brand.
Swarm/Worker/Warrior/Explorer exactly reuse established Bengali gameplay nouns. Skep/clutch describe actual building mesh forms.
Music guidance uses respectful commands and ambience wording; named শান্ত/নির্মাণ/যুদ্ধ modes and audible alignment/noise distinctions are preserved.
Match verdict pending/failed/unverifiable semantics distinguish success from mere check completion.
Admin metric placeholders are translated library/product names; final Bengali genitives and কাজ prevent malformed composed headings. Dispute closed does not imply a particular financial outcome.
verdict: All 105 new source/target pairs actually examined. Seven editorial improvements applied, including both initial semantic findings. Ready for independent final semantic recheck of all 105 edited/retained targets.
